description: Read the source of a Cursor canvas. Pass `canvas_id` for a canvas in this run's store, or a canonical https://cursor.com/canvas/<storeId>/<canvasId> `url` to read another store's canvas or a shared canvas. If both are provided they must name the same canvas id and the url's storeId is used for the read; a malformed url is ignored when `canvas_id` is present.

canvas_id.description: The id of a canvas in this run's store to read. When both `canvas_id` and `url` are provided they must name the same canvas id; the url's storeId is used for the read.

url.description: A canonical https://cursor.com/canvas/<storeId>/<canvasId> canvas url. Use this to read a canvas in another store or from a share link. A malformed url is ignored when `canvas_id` is present; if both resolve they must name the same canvas id and this url's storeId is used for the read.
